name: PowOS warm Gradle pool (.58)
purpose: powos-gradle-pool: the gradle-pool service of tools/jobs/compose.yml - warm Gradle daemons for agents' Kotlin compile checks (tools/phone/compile-check.sh) and JVM unit tests (tools/agents/jvm-offload.sh), each worktree synced into its own /work/<checkout>, at most POOL_SLOTS (3) builds at once. Under nomad.slice (.58's 24-thread job cap). Idle: daemons exit after 2 h, the container ends itself after POOL_IDLE_H (2) h without a run; the next run starts it again
installedBy: tools/jobs/gradle-pool.sh run (on demand, docker --context pow58 compose -p powos-gradle-pool up gradle-pool)
files: podman volume powos-jobs-gradle-pool (its Gradle home, seeded once from powos-jobs-gradle)
podman volume powos-jobs-gradle-pool-work (per-worktree sources + build dirs)
docker --context pow58 volume rm powos-jobs-gradle-pool powos-jobs-gradle-pool-work
